pkgmove safety report: example.com/fx/hub -> example.com/fx/hub/sub
Files moved: 1. Findings: 3. Errors: 0.

Why this matters: a moved package is initialised before the package that
imports it, so init() functions and package-level var initialisers in the moved
files now run before every initialiser of the source package. Review each
ERROR/HIGH/WARN item below before merging.

== HIGH: exported struct field (reflection/encoding visibility changes) ==
  hub/move.go:9: embedded Outer.inner -> Inner (follows the exported type): reflection, encoding, templates and %+v now see this field (types in other packages that embed Outer are not checked for shadowing)

== WARN: reflect-visible type name changes (all users, not only moved files) ==
  hub/move.go:3: hub.inner becomes sub.Inner for %T, reflect Type.String/PkgPath, gob names and messages that print type names (the alias keeps identity, not the name)
  hub/move.go:8: hub.Outer becomes sub.Outer for %T, reflect Type.String/PkgPath, gob names and messages that print type names (the alias keeps identity, not the name)
